title: Marshmallow Minis - Body and Lip Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A set of holiday minis in your favorite marshmallow scent, featuring travel-ready sizes of Body Butter Balm, Body Fragrance Mist, and Lip Butter Balm.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, and Combination


Ingredient Callouts: These products are vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This limited-edition set includes buttery body care, award-winning lip care, and a sensorial body mist in Marshmallow—Summer Fridays’ coziest scent yet. Moisturize with Body Butter Balm, nourish lips with Lip Butter Balm, and indulge your senses with Body Fragrance Mist—available exclusively in this set.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-The Marshmallow Minis Routine: Moisturize with Body Butter Balm Marshmallow, spritz on Body Fragrance Mist Marshmallow, and nourish with Lip Butter Balm Toasted Marshmallow
Ingredients+
Lip Butter Balm Toasted Marshmallow:
Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Diisostearyl Malate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Hydrogenated Poly(C6- 14 Olefin), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Microcrystalline Wax/Cera Microcristallina/Cire Microcristalline, Octyldodecanol, Synthetic Wax, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Vanillin, Flavor/Aroma, Mica, Polyglyceryl-2 Diisostearate, Propylene Carbonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Alumina, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf Extract, Tin Oxide, Citrus Aurantium Amara (Bitter Orange) Peel Oil, BHT, Limonene, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491).

Body Butter Balm Toasted Marshmallow:
Water/Aqua/Eau, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Oil, Propanediol, Cetearyl Alcohol, Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Dipentaerythrityl Hexa C5-9 Acid Esters, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cetearyl Olivate, Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Shorea Stenoptera Seed Butter, Ceramide NP, Phytosphingosine, Squalane, Arginine, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil, Brassica Campestris (Rapeseed) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Mica, Sorbitan Olivate, Polysorbate 60, Hydroxyacetophenone, Potassium Cetyl Phosphate, Caprylyl Glycol, Tromethamine, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Behenyl Alcohol, Arachidyl Alcohol, Triethylhexanoin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Arachidyl Glucoside, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Tin Oxide, Glyceryl Stearate, Stearic Acid, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Carbomer, Fragrance (Parfum), Vanillin, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Limonene, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891).

Body Fragrance Mist Toasted Marshmallow:
Alcohol Denat., Water/Aqua/Eau, Fragrance/Parfum, Vanilin, Anise Alcohol.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
